T_MenuSelectNetwork: Add and select supported blockchain networks.

T_MenuSelectAccount: And and select Wallets and Accounts.
T_EditWallet: Open Wallet Settings. If any Accounts refer to parent wallet, they will be applied to those accounts.
T_EditAccount: Opens account settings for this specific selected account.
T_AllTransactions: Opens a list of all loaded transactions on chain on this netowrk.
T_Page: Browse the pages of these entries.
T_Sort1: Entries will be primarily sorted by this part.
T_Sort2: Entried will be secondarily sorted by this part. (Within primary groups of idential primarily sorted entries)
T_Increasing1: Primary sorting in increasing order? If unchecked, it will be decreasing
T_Increasing2: Secondary sorting in increasing order? If unchecked, it will be decreasing
T_Enable: Show only entries that satisfy this conditiion.
T_Regexp: Filter the entries by the text of this part. Supports RexExp format.
T_FilterMinValue: Minimum amount of the matching enty.
T_FilterMaxValue: Minimum amount of the matching entry.
T_FilterMinDate: Earliest date of the matching entry.
T_FilterMaxDate: Latest date of the matching entry.
T_FilterTicker: Filter by the name of attached asset. Supports RexExp format.

Filter by the amount for those tokens with the matching name.

T_FilterMinTokens: Minimum amount of the matching tokens.

T_BookProfile.Interface: Interface page of the settings. Change how the app looksand controls.
T_BookProfile.Performance: Performance page of the settings. Advanced tuning of algorithms, and cutting corners on behavior.
T_BookProfile.Debug: Debug page of the settings. Useful for developers and tester.
T_BookProfile.Language: Choose the localization language for the app.
T_BookProfile.DateFormat: Choose or write how to display date and time.
T_BookProfile.DisplayMode: Multi-Window is a desktop mode that lets you open everything in its separate window.
T_BookProfile.ShowTooltips: Show tooltips with exra description when you hover over things. 0 Disables them, positive sets their delay in milliseconds.
T_BookProfile.ControlFont: Choose the font for the interactive elements of the wallet.
T_BookProfile.ControlFontSize: Choose the font size for the interactive elements of the wallet.
T_BookProfile.InfoFont: Choose the font for the informational elements of the wallet.
T_BookProfile.InfoFontSize: Choose the font size for the informational elements of the wallet.
T_BookProfile.MaxTasks: Howmany CPU threads can the app use at maximum? (It will only do it briefly during tasks like filtering large lists)
T_BookProfile.Reset: Resets everything on this page to factory settings.
T_BookProfile.SortAlgo:
Choose a parallel algorithm to use for sorting very large sets.
BucketIntro - most advanced, over 200 lines of code, might be the fastest but also needs a lot of testing.
It recursively bucket sorts to get relatively evenly sized chunks, that it wil lthen intro sort each, and concatenate.
IntroMerge - the simplest parallel sort I could think of. It intro sorts into chunks, and then parallel merge sorts them.
Intro is just the regular single-threaded Intro Sort, that C# comes with.
T_BookProfile.DefaultToSingle: How many entries does it take to start using parallel processing, like the above chosen algorithm, instead of the regular Intro sort? (Choosing intro just effectively disables this)
T_BookProfile.SplitChildren: First we bucket sort the entries into at most this many buckets.
T_BookProfile.MinMaxBucketSize: Buckets over this size will be bucket sorted to split them further into SplitChildren.
T_BookProfile.DistributionTiers:
The final buckets will have to be assigned to parallel intro sorts.
So first we bucket sort the actual list sizes, so that we can zig-zag fill the task queue from the relatively largest to smallest tasks.
T_BookProfile.SpinInstructions: If a higher layer merge node gets blocked by lower node, it will first spin to wait this many instructions. If it is still blcoked then, it will yield the thread.
T_BookProfile.VolatileBuffer: How often will merge nodes update the finished length to the node above them. It an exponent in a power of two. So 6 means reporting in 64 element batches
T_BookProfile.DebugLocale: Will encapsulate all text that tried and failed to get a localized transalation into brackets. missing -> [-missing-]
T_AddNetwork: Add a new network. It will then select itself, and will appear or this list.
T_SelectNetwork: Select this blockchain. You could then access your accounts andtransaction on it.
T_BookNetwork.AddressBook: Remember specific addresses, assign colors to them, and blacklist or whitelist them.
T_BookNetwork.RemoveNetwork:
Disconnects and removes the network from available networks list.
You will not lose any data on it, just the accessibility. You can later re-add it back.
T_AddAddress: Add a new Address to the Address book. It will then appear on this list and links everywhere it matches.
T_BookAddress.AddressName: Make a custom name that will link to the address.
T_BookAddress.SelectAddressColor: Select a custom color that will this address be displayed everywhere with.
T_BookAddress.CustomAddress: Select a custom color that will this address be displayed everywhere with.
T_BookAddress.RuleDeposit: How will the transaction builder react if you attempt to send value over the limit TO this address. (useful for limiting yourself from sending to some recipients)
T_BookAddress.RuleDepositValue: Limit of the deposit value, if you try to send more than this much TO this address, the Rule will get triggered.
T_BookAddress.RuleWitdraw: How will the transaction builder react if you attempt to send value over the limit FROM this address. (useful for limiting your expenses)
T_BookAddress.RuleWitdrawValue: Limit of the withdraw value, if you try to send more than this much FROM this address, the Rule will get triggered.
T_BookAddress.RemoveAddress: Deletes this address from the address book.
